5f4j:
Students will benefit from a broad introduction to commerce, exploring the various functions found within almost all businesses – from operations to marketing, accounting and human resource management. Students will develop an understanding of how and where businesses sell their products and services, who they sell to, how they make decisions, and what improves their chances of success.

This course can be studied full-time over three years, or four years if students choose to add a placement year in industry. There’s also a two and a half-year accelerated option, and a part-time option. There are intakes in October and January.
5f4v:
The course is the ideal springboard for those who are looking for a successful management career in one of the world’s fastest-growing industries. Hospitality and tourism offer exciting career opportunities because, despite the broader economic outlook, these industries continue to thrive around the world – and employers are always looking for accomplished graduates. This exciting, fast-paced and highly practical course will prepare students for a wide range of management and leadership positions, all with a global perspective and within a multi-cultural environment.

Students will engage regularly with top employers and there are multiple opportunities to explore the industries in action. And where better to study than Coventry's London campus, surrounded by some of the world’s most iconic hotels and attractions, which are visited by over 32 million tourists a year?

5f4h:
Where better to study financial economics and banking than London, one of the world’s leading financial centres? At Coventry's London campus, students will be surrounded by hundreds of financial institutions. We’re just a few minutes’ walk from the traditional financial district (which includes the Bank of England and the London Stock Exchange) and we’re also within view of Canary Wharf, the new financial district in East London. The department will arrange visits to these centres, and students may apply to have the opportunity to do an internship there.

This course provides the ideal blend of academic theory and hands-on experience. In class, students will work on practical exercises such as case studies and business, banking or trading simulations. They will be taught to do real workplace tasks using industry-standard technology, and we encourage contact with financial firms which may be through work experience and visits to companies and institutions.

626i:
Acquire the knowledge and develop the skills to pursue a career in the broader economics and finance sector.

The Economics, Banking and Finance course offers ethics-based finance education and has been designed to equip students with the level of knowledge and skills required for positions with global employers such as commercial banks, investment banks, asset managers, and many other financial services and investment companies.

Explore the main theories of economics and finance and work with economic and financial data to examine how different activities and external events affect the world. Evaluate policy decisions by governments or central banks and other financial institutions and analyse their impact on the financial sector and the overall economy. Study on a course which provides focus on practical elements of the subjects, moving away from the traditional approach of theoretical and advanced technical analysis that requires strong mathematical background.

5f51:
The Financial Technology (FinTech) MSc is aimed at students who are looking to gain a broad yet thorough understanding of the financial technology sector. The course features an innovative and interdisciplinary curriculum that helps students to develop the relevant hard and soft skills they will need for careers in FinTech.

In addition to traditional finance and IT programming skills, it integrates both real business and practical blended knowledge within the FinTech landscape and the hottest trends in technologies within the disruptive financial sector.

The course is perfect for any student looking for a master’s level FinTech course which is not only focused on technical computing/software engineering, but also incorporates elements of entrepreneurship, innovation, regulation, marketing and business strategy.

5f56:
From the heart of London’s exciting financial district, get ready to take part in the increasingly fast-moving, complex and exciting world of international financial services. Since the global financial crisis of 2008, fundamental and far-reaching changes have required leaders in this sector to think and behave in a new way. Wide-ranging political, regulatory and technological responses to these changes, as well as new business opportunities and challenges, form part of the new landscape. This MBA explores the implications of all these changes, preparing graduates to lead the financial services organisations of the future.

This program will equip students for a high-flying career in financial services, whether they've just completed undergraduate studies or have been working for some time, and whether they need an MBA to accelerate their career progression or want to move into this sector for the first time. It offers the flexibility of start dates in October and January plus options for full- or part-time study.

In addition to gaining academic skills and knowledge, MBA students have the opportunity to undertake a professional development program designed to develop career plans, improve professional skills, and increase employability.
5f53:
In this program, students develop the skills they need to join a new generation of strategic business leaders, learning to create, develop and sustainably grow organizations which competitively operate in a global context.

Graduates of this course demonstrate advanced expertise in marketing, finance, global human-resource management, international business, international trade, project management, strategy and leadership. Learning is very much applied: students will get superb exposure to practical skills and the world of work, and they will graduate as confident, career-ready individuals with real employer appeal in any industry.

The course is available both full-time and part-time, and will suit anyone from recent graduates to those who have been working for some years. Students could also achieve a joint award: passing 2 aligned course modules makes them eligible for the CMI Certificate in Strategic Management and Leadership.

In addition to gaining academic skills and knowledge, MBA students have the opportunity to undertake a professional development program designed to develop career plans, improve professional skills, and increase employability.
61sk:
Enhance existing skills, knowledge and understanding of leadership and management in a healthcare organisation, to help tackle the needs of modern twenty-first-century healthcare.

The MBA in Global Healthcare Management and Leadership is an exciting, vibrant, intensive course that aims to prepare students for successful careers in multi-discipline, healthcare leadership, and management roles globally. Responding to global market trends, the healthcare economy, and constant change, this course addresses the needs of a new generation of healthcare business leaders.

Study on a contemporary, CMI accredited course reflecting the latest developments in healthcare management and leadership theories and inspiring and nurturing knowledge, aptitude and skills, which are needed to advance students' career in healthcare. Develop an analytical understanding of global healthcare business in the context of an increasingly changing environment, through the critical analysis and evaluation of new concepts and managerial practices in addressing today’s macro and micro business environment. Take advantage of business simulations and apply the acquired personal and professional skills into real business situations, evaluating the results and developing solutions. Experience career-relevant teaching and learning, which maximises students' exposure to the corporate world.
5f59:
This is a challenging, fast-paced and stimulating MBA course, designed to offer the industry-specific business and management skills students need to build a successful career in international fashion management. This course offers a comprehensive understanding of the business of fashion, rather than teaching students to be a designer or producer, so that they can build a career in management or leadership. It focuses on the global and technological shifts which have characterised the industry in recent years; the management of fashion design and product development; and international fashion manufacturing and retailing strategies.

Applicants may have recently completed an undergraduate degree, in fashion or any other discipline. Alternatively, they may have been working for some time and want to accelerate their career progression in fashion, or to make a move into fashion for the first time.

In addition to gaining academic skills and knowledge, MBA students have the opportunity to undertake a professional development program designed to develop career plans, improve professional skills, and increase employability.
5f5e:
More and more organisations recognise that finding (and keeping) the best talent, and getting the most out of them, is critical to their future success.

This MBA course will prepare students for a career in HR leadership – helping a wide range of organisations to grow and prosper. Study for this MBA and build a successful strategic management career, developing people in the complex and fast-changing world of the contemporary workplace. Students will graduate with a solid understanding of how and why people function at work, and of the relevant legal frameworks governing human resource management. They will also deepen their understanding of how to find, develop and engage the most appropriate talent for any organisation.

Students will study at Coventry's exciting London campus. Upon successful completion, they will be awarded the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD) Advanced Diploma in HRM, and they could also obtain the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) Certificate in Strategic Management and Leadership.

In addition to gaining academic skills and knowledge, MBA students have the opportunity to undertake a professional development program designed to develop career plans, improve professional skills, and increase employability.
